$comment: Canonical parity screen list. Web (capture-web.mjs) is the reference; native clients reach the same screen with the same fixture data. Placeholders in route: {movie:<title>} and {series:<title>} resolve to a catalogue work id, {file:<title>} to the first media file id of that work.

tv.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; BRAVIA) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 PlayarrAndroidTV/1.0

themeStorage.note: The web app resolves its theme from this key, else prefers-color-scheme. References set both, so a native client may use either the system appearance or its own setting.
